question: Does the CNCF and Ampere sponsored Actuated programme still accept projects in 2026?
why: the vendor FAQ still listed the programme on 2026-11-04, but the Arm servers it ran on were hosted by Equinix Metal, which ended service on 2026-06-30, and the CNCF Community Cluster that supplied the credits was decommissioned on 2025-12-31; no captured page says whether the pool moved to another host, while GitHub now offers free arm64 hosted runners in public repositories (https://github.blog/changelog/2025-01-16-linux-arm64-hosted-runners-now-available-for-free-in-public-repositories-public-preview/) for projects that need only standard sizes
